criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Frames 1, 4 and 9 are real staged renders; the dog reads as smooth clay. Frame 5 a primitive monitor with a flat UI mock on a lifted wall, frame 3 no visible car or phone, frame 8 an empty clay band above one slab, frames 6 and 7 two 8x4 grids back to back. The reliefs meet the physical bar.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One key, one register, one accent meaning detection, one dog. 6 and 7 read as the same grid twice; 5 sits slightly outside.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and quotes are verbatim, the 2019 finding is refused, sources primary. Against: the release's future tense flattened into present fact (cover, S3, S7, S9, caption); S3's kicker and lens lines give the checks to software; S5 asserts a machine-first order and ticks future verification; S8 turns a window into a duration; 'car' narrows 'vehicle'; web dek 'A person reviews every clip' and 'a few seconds from a passing car'; docket history 'Field research is under way' unsourced and key_dates 'effective' for an announcement.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where, when named; the appearance label is the strongest idea, nothing says what it is used for and there is no reader action.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: S3 and S5, S6 and S7, S8 and S9 are near duplicates.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Plain and on register; flat lines on S2, S9 and the caption opener; S5's dek is the release sentence as house prose.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: New topic; familiar staged lastLight world, caliche reliefs, type in the top 40 percent on all nine frames.

ranked_defects.defect: Kicker and lens lines attribute the four checks to software.
ranked_defects.fix: Kicker 'What the review checks'; labels on the box corners only, no sight lines from the lens.

ranked_defects.defect: 'Then a person checks the call' asserts an order; ticked rows show a future verification.
ranked_defects.fix: Hook 'A person reviews the clip too'; rows unticked.

ranked_defects.defect: 'is surveying' presents deployment as under way; 'car' narrows 'vehicle'.
ranked_defects.fix: Hook 'A phone on a vehicle window will survey San Antonio's loose dogs'; title to match.

ranked_defects.defect: 'Three months on the street' turns a window into a duration.
ranked_defects.fix: Hook 'October to December on the street, then a report'.

ranked_defects.defect: Web dek universal and unsourced clause; docket history 'under way'; key_dates 'effective'.
ranked_defects.fix: Dek 'Automated and human review will check the clips'; delete the few-seconds clause; history 'expected to run through December 2026' (c20); key_dates kind announced.

ranked_defects.defect: Hook states a future delivery in the present and repeats S8.
Caption paragraph 3 present tense where the release says 'will'.
ranked_defects.fix: Put it in the future tense.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Primitive monitor, flat UI mock, lifted wall, named person absent.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Reviewer's dark shoulder and forearm silhouette lit by the screen, wall to true black.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Empty clay band above a low slab.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Rule at about half height, block a third of the width or more, crop the dead band.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: No readable car or phone; labels on dark plates.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Car roof rail and window phone in the bottom right quarter, lens the convergence point.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A second 8x4 grid straight after slide 6.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Low oblique raking view across mould and cast.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Phone on a stalk pedestal, not clamped to glass.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Model the clamp jaws gripping the lowered glass edge.
